selection: All occurrences in the 30 previously frozen complete seat-transition clusters; no addition, replacement or outcome-based priority

occurrenceOrder.rule: ascending lowercase SHA-256 UTF-8 of seed|candidateOccurrenceId
occurrenceOrder.orderedIdsEncoding: one candidateOccurrenceId followed by newline, in acquisition order

sourceHierarchy: Preserved official election-local candidature table establishes occurrence only; it does not itself prove cross-election person identity.

Reassess preserved Stage 8 direct winner anchors, Stage 9 dated service profiles and Stage 10 occurrence-specific official/party evidence from their raw sources; inherited probable chains remain projections.
For a still uncorroborated sampled occurrence, search official Electoral Commission/election-result and New Zealand Parliament pages for a dated occurrence-specific candidate or service fact.
If needed, search a party's own dated selection, nomination or candidate announcement; accept an authoritative mirror only when author/date/original party provenance is clear.

searchProcedure.firstQuery: Full preserved candidate name, electorate, election year, Electoral Commission or Parliament official domains; inspect results for occurrence-specific dated facts.
searchProcedure.secondQuery: Same full name, electorate, election year and preserved party label, seeking a dated official party nomination/selection statement or authoritative mirror.
searchProcedure.resultChoice: Within a query, use the first independently occurrence-specific authoritative result under the source hierarchy; log rejected results and reasons. Do not choose by winner status, residual or attractive relation.
searchProcedure.alreadyResolved: After the uniform preserved audit, no external search is needed when an occurrence is directly corroborated; this is an evidence-sufficiency rule, not an inherited-label priority rule.
searchProcedure.sharedSource: A preserved or newly registered page can support multiple fixed-cohort occurrences only with a separate text/fact/date check for each; it never adds candidates or changes order.

budget.counting: A unique successfully preserved authoritative resource counts once. A shared page or a duplicate canonical URL/identical raw SHA-256 is reused and counts once; search attempts and failed retrievals count against the per-occurrence two-search cap but not the 60-resource cap.
budget.deduplication: Canonicalize scheme/host case, remove fragment and tracking parameters while preserving meaningful path/query; also compare original raw SHA-256. Keep aliases and exact fetched URL in provenance.
budget.stop: Stop at 60 new unique resources or after at most two searches for each remaining uncorroborated occurrence. Keep not-reached-budget-exhausted distinct from searched-but-unresolved; never replace difficult cases or spend the remaining budget merely to reach 60.

ledgerContract: For every ordered occurrence record preserved-evidence review, each query and timestamp, result URL/domain, acceptance or rejection reason, retrieval failure, reused/new source ID, checksum, fact/publication/retrieval dates, and final status. Empty search attempts before acquisition are explicit pending records, not failed searches.
adjudicationContract: Keep person existence, occurrence confidence, same/different-person relation and dated electorate/list tenure separate. Direct occurrence corroboration may confirm; name/party/seat projections stay probable; conflicting or inadequate proof stays unresolved. Retrospective winner/profile coverage is labelled and cannot create a prospective as-of link when publication timing is unknown.
